<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[FSM SLAs provide urgency signals Now Assist uses for AI-driven work order prioritization and scheduling.]]></ai_justification><check_name>FSM Service Level Agreements</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(checkDef, dateFilter) {
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('sla');
    ga.addQuery('table', 'CONTAINS', 'wm_order');
    ga.addQuery('active', true);
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.query();
    var count = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT')) : 0;

    var actualValue = count + ' active FSM SLA definitions';

    if (count >= 3) {
        return {
            status: 'ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: count + ' active FSM SLAs. Now Assist FSM can prioritize dispatch using AI-driven SLA breach risk analysis.'
        };
    } else if (count >= 1) {
        return {
            status: 'needs_attention',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' active FSM SLA(s) (target: 3+). Now Assist FSM SLA-based AI prioritization will have limited differentiation across work order types.'
        };
    } else {
        return {
            status: 'not_ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'No active FSM SLAs defined. Now Assist FSM cannot differentiate work order urgency for AI dispatch prioritization without SLA definitions.'
        };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>FIELD_SERVICE</module><number>CHK0003254</number><order>100</order><remediation_guidance>Configure FSM SLAs for each work order type and customer tier via the SLA configuration.
